children.title: CNAPP
lines: Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform - one platform combining posture + workload + data + API security.

children.title: CSPM
lines: Cloud Security Posture Management - finds and ranks cloud misconfigurations (public buckets, open security groups).

children.title: AI-SPM / SPM
lines: Security Posture Management with AI-driven behavior analytics and risk scoring - proactive threat finding before exploitation.

children.title: CIEM
lines: Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management - least-privilege over identities: finds s3:*-style wildcards, unused keys, and over-privileged roles.

children.title: CWPP
lines: Cloud Workload Protection Platform - runtime protection of hosts and containers (syscall- and process-level).

children.title: DSPM
lines: Data Security Posture Management - discovers where sensitive data lives and who flows it out.

children.title: ASPM
lines: Application Security Posture Management - bridges code vulnerabilities to cloud infrastructure exposure.

children.title: CTEM
lines: Continuous Threat Exposure Management - operating loop: enumerate attack surface → prioritize → validate → remediate.

children.title: XDR
lines: Extended Detection & Response - SIEM + endpoint detection + correlation under one umbrella.

children.title: MDR / managed SOC
lines: Managed Detection & Response - a partner runs 24/7 detection/response for you (the "agentic SOC" products live here).

children.title: SOAR
lines: Security Orchestration, Automation & Response - playbook engine that chains detections into automated actions (with HITL gates).
